name: io.github.hpdkhoa/poselab-mcp
title: Pose Lab
description: Measured spatial answers for posing first-person arms and a rifle in Blender

environmentVariables.name: POSELAB_BLENDER
environmentVariables.description: Blender's executable, if it is not on the PATH or in the usual install folder

environmentVariables.name: POSELAB_RIGS
environmentVariables.description: A rigs.json describing your own FBX rigs; the built-in sample rig needs none

environmentVariables.name: POSELAB_OUT
environmentVariables.description: The only folder Pose Lab writes to (renders, the worker's log); defaults to ~/.poselab
